title: Jack and the Snow That Was Not Even
synopsis: Jack measures snow on open ground while Gus discovers how wind builds deeper drifts. Mr. Lee clears a Pine Park walkway with a snowblower, but the bench remains covered in snow.
continuity_state: Before: Snow remains in Pine Park despite road and farm-lane clearance. The pine, bench, gravel path, and Pancake Hill are intact. A drift has collected beside the park fence and bench; Jack has his original blue notebook. After: Jack and Aunt Jo measured snow at an open, undisturbed spot and compared it with a wind-built drift without treating the drift as representative. Mr. Lee used a walk-behind snowblower to clear a park access path with the chute facing an empty verge; the adults inspected the path. Jack recorded the snow-depth sketch beside his earlier rain-route drawing. The park hill and rain gauge are unchanged.
